steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: All of the Reunion teams I could reach have pulled out.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: That's a lot of people.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: It's incredible... like a river.

steps.name: Nesti
steps.text: It'll be a river out there in the wilderness... a river of refugees.

steps.name: Nesti
steps.text: There's Ursus and Lugmenites out there. Infected and ordinary folk alike. No matter what they came with, they're leaving empty-handed.

steps.name: Nesti
steps.text: They thought there was a place that would take them. Now they know there's never anywhere they could've gone.

steps.name: Nesti
steps.text: This river won't flow forever.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: (He sounds so sad.)

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: (He picked that up from Big Daddy.)

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: (No wonder. Anyone would get sentimental at a time like this.)

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: If Big Daddy was here, we would've won the fight and it wouldn't have come to this, huh?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: It's the luck of the draw. No use thinking about how things could've been.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: ......Get ready. I'll go talk it over with the Phantom Crossbowmen.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Don't rush me. It's not like I don't know.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Hurry up already. Quit screwing around.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: I'm pretty choked up too!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It's Yeti Squad.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What about Amiya and her people?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: They're already on their way. Amiya said to tell you to 'take it easy'.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She knows better than to tell me that. It's me, Blaze. When do I ever take it easy?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Blaze! Where are you going?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: To save lives!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Crossbowmen! Wait up!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Yetis... what are you doing?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: It's Sister FrostNova... She's growing weak. She can't keep this up for long.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: She exhausted her energy pushing back Lungmen's forces. She may not wake up for a while.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: You mean you want us to take her with us?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: But we aren't going back to Chernobog. Faust didn't want Mephisto to go back...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: We're begging you!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: We want Sister to be together with Patriot, in the end!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: We know, they're not exactly getting along right now, but... their bond is stronger than blood.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: So please... we beg of you.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: And what will you do?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: We'll cover you. If we don't hold them back, the Lungmenites will catch you in no time.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Once you're all far enough away from Lungmen that you're no longer a threat to them, they'll give up the chase.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: But that means, you guys will...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Live by the sword, die by the sword. We're okay with dying in battle.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: The future that Sister FrostNova spoke of is still a ways away. But we don't need to see it for ourselves.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: We owe you our lives.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: That's nothing. You're saving our Sister.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...We will do what you ask of us. I swear it.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Take these armguards. And put on this protective suit.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: What for?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Our Sister is far too cold for you.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...She's so light...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: The Arts have emptied her body. Easy now, easy...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Don't wake her.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Look at her... look how softly she sleeps.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Goodbye, Sister...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: We'll be waiting for you.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...All right then.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Let's... move on.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: It's us that's moving on.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: We'll meet again, Yetis.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Not too soon, I hope.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: Are we going to die?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: *Ursine profanity*, what are you crying for?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Are you a Yeti or not?!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: Are you not crying?!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: What am I crying about...?! Did you forget what Sister said?!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: She said not to cry.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Right! She said not to cry... More than a decade ago, she said not to cry! So I don't want to see any tears! We don't get to cry... because we haven't won yet!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: Once we win, once we're free...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Once we're free, we'll cry our eyes out, in the wilderness, in the snow, in the stacks of wheat piled high, we'll be bawling!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Sister was crying as she said it, you know.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: She was only nine at the time. We were all a little older than her...

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Without her, we would have died in that mine.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Did you bring the sauce?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Bring the what...? Wait, I thought we weren't allowed to bring it?

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: You're not allowed to drink on the march, but you had it with you, I know.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: I want a drink too...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: You're not old enough yet, are you?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: B- but I've never tried before. I don't want to die without ever tasting it...

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Give him a little.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Petrova...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Fine, take a swig. But not too much, we all need a share.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Na zdorovye, brothers! Warm up!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: To Sister! And Big Daddy!

steps.name: Yeti Squad All Together
steps.text: To FrostNova! And Patriot!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Do you know these Infected?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I do, Officer Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But this final battle must be fought.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do we have a choice?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We may not.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Look behind you. They're not even trying to hide themselves anymore.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...The black raincoats.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So, we have to fight them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This is what we must do. If we don't, we'll fall short. And the business of pushing the special forces into the Yetis becomes pretty unconvincing.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Unless you could convince them to surrender?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As long as there's Infected behind them... they won't give up.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Amiya.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I won't force you to fight.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, Officer Ch'en. But... but we will witness it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The L. G. D. fought bravely, no one can deny that. You fought for Lungmen, against the invaders.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is how we will help you against those special forces.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And for our sake... We must record every battle for the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Every single one.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Officer Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: When this battle is over, let's grab a bite together.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: B- but I'm Infected...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't care. The loudmouth and the tall lady? They won't mind either.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This battle... it's going to cost a lot.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: For us, it's a battle.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: For Lungmen, it's a war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And that's what war is.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But whoever it was who planned all this, they're not here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Say, there's something I have to tell you——

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ——But not right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah. Not right now, Officer Ch'en.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor......

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Mhm.

options: But just like in the ruins of Chernobog...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're right. I decided.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I need to see it... with my own eyes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Together.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: So we don't call her Big Sister because she's older than us...? Why am I just learning this now?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Well, it works for you. You were three years old back then.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: Pfft!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Hey, what's with the attitude? Did you get drunk off two sips? When you cried out for food, did I feed you or not?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: That was then, this is... now!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: You know, it's funny. I'm suddenly thinking about those Rhodes Islanders.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: That one cat, with the hot body, the one who said she wanted to drink with us.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: It's too bad. She looked like she'd be able to hold her liquor. She looked like a real good time.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: But the little rabbit, she can't be old enough yet?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: What is she? 16? 17?

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: More like 14. She just seems older because she talks fancy.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: As old as Sister was... back then.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Let's toast them one more time.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: So it is said, so shall it be done!

steps.name: Nesti
steps.text: So shall it be done!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member D
steps.text: Um, uh... so shall it be done!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Lungmenites should be more coordinated.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Get out of here. The Yetis can only hold them for a while.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You don't think what they're doing is incredible?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: If we die, then they did it all for nothing.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: The Phantom Crossbowmen say we can't go back to Chernobog. So we're going to a new place.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You don't care where our new base is?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Wherever it is, I'm going with you.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Heh. You Lungmenites are no different from us.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I was hoping they'd treat you better here. Turns out it's the same as it was in Ursus.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Infected suffer the same everywhere.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: That's not what you said when you first got here.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: People change.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yetis? Are those the Yetis?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's the Yetis! R- right...? Definitely!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yetiiiis... Yetiiii! Why are you Yetis like this?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Damn it! Don't die! I won't let you die!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Just hold on, I can save you! I'll get you to safety...!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why do you Infected want to die here?!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: The special forces stopped attacking? No, looks like they're pulling back...?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Seems... they're giving us the initiative.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Are we showing the power of Lungmen's law enforcement? *Lungmen profanity* They underestimated us!

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: ...Never mind.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Listen up, this is the last wave! Don't disappoint the people, or Ch'en Sir.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: We'll show Reunion how powerful Lungmen is! The Infected won't dare attack our city again!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Phantom Crossbowmen, don't let us down. You have to get our Sister back to the old man.

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: ...She's running out of time. She should spend it with him.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: We don't have much time left ourselves, eh?

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Ready?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Ready. Let's give back our lives.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Let's show them what the squad trained by Buldrokkas'tee, Ursus's greatest soldier, and led by it's coldest nightmare, can do!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: The last of Sister's Originium Arts...

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Frost Originium, ready to loose!

steps.name: Petrova
steps.text: Nesti! We're coming!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yetiiiiiiiiiis!!!
